Rahida Khatun vs The State Of Jharkhand ...... Opposite ... on 6
June, 2023
Author: Rajesh Kumar

Bench: Rajesh Kumar
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 A.B.A. No.3196 of 2022
 1. Rahida Khatun
 2. Nasrin Aara
 3. Md. Sohel Tanveer ...... Petitioners
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand ...... Opposite Party
 -----
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
 -----
 For the Petitioners : Mrs. Archanan Kumari Singh, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. S.K.Shukla, A.P.P
 For the Informant : Mr. A.K.Sahani, Adv.
 Mr. G.K.Pandey, Adv.
 -----
 10/Dated: 06/06/2023
Apprehending their arrest, the applicants have moved this Court for grant of privilege of
anticipatory bail in connection with Keredari P.S. Case No.119 of 2021, registered for the offence
under Sections 341/ 342/ 323/ 307/ 504 and 498A of Ipc and Sections 3/4 of D.P. Act.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Innocence have been claimed and undertaking have been given for co- operation with the investigating agency and for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that they have been wrongly roped in the present case and no role have been assigned to them.
Hence, they may be granted the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned A.P.P and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the above fact, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicants.

Accordingly, the applicants are directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from the date of receipt/production of this order and in the event of their arrest or surrender, the Court below shall enlarge the applicants on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand)
each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M.1st Class,
Hazaribagh in connection with Keredari P.S. Case No.119 of 2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
